DOP: uddeka m. [ cf S. udreka, “excess” ], vomiting; belching ; Vin I 277, 7 (imassa kho rañño sappi pītaṃ pariṇāmentaṃ ~aṃ dassati; Sp 1117, 13 : ~aṃ dassatī ti uggāraṃ dassati); Vism 261, 11 (~o pi mukhaṃ pi duggandhaṃ pūtikuṇapa-sadisaṃ hoti; ≠ Pj I 61, 31 : uggāro pi); — see also udreka.
CPD: uddeka , m. [ sa. udreka different meaning ] , eruc- tation, belching; rañño sappi pītaṃ pariṇāmentaṃ ~aṃ dassati (adāsi), Vin l 277, 7, 27 (= uggāraṃ, Sp 1117, 13 ); udaraṃ . . . kuṇapa-gandhaṃ hoti, tato uggatena ca gandhena ~o ( v. l. udreko) pi mukham pi duggandhaṃ . . . hoti, Vism 261, 11 (~o pittâdīhi vinā kevalo uddhaṅgama-vāto, mhṭ S e ll 30, 10 = B e l 308, 5 ) = Vibh-a 244, 17 ( C e uggāro) ≠ Pj l 61, 31 (uggāro).

uddesa.p: [U+disa(disī)+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) The words (sound) that express in summary, Summarized words, Uddesa (sermon statement in brief), Headlines, Table of contents. See original.
a: (၁)အကျဉ်းပြဆို- ဟော- ကြောင်းဖြစ်သော စကားရပ်၊ အကျဉ်းစကား၊ အကျဉ်းဒေသနာ၊ ခေါင်းစဉ်။ မာတိကာ။မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။

H: uddesa：m．[＜uddisati] 說示，總說，說戒，誦經，素姓（出身，血統，來歷），境遇．-bhatta 個別請食（指定食）．-vāra 總說分．
S: uddesa：m．[＜uddisati] 説示，總説，説戒，誦經，素姓，境遇．-bhatta 別請食．-vāra 總説分．
D: Uddesa，【阳】 1．指示。 2．提出，3．朗诵。 ~ka，【形】指出的人，背诵者。~sika，【形】 指出，提到，纪念物。 （与 vassa【合】），有…的年龄。（p69）
F: Uddesa，（fr．uddisati） --，【阳】1．指示（1．pointing out，setting forth，proposition，exposition，indication，programme）。2．解释（explanation），3．朗诵。uddesaka，【形】指出的人，背诵者。uddesika，【形】指引，提到，纪念物。（与 vassa【合】），有…的年龄。

P: Uddesa，[fr．uddisati] -- 1．pointing out，setting forth，proposition，exposition，indication，programme M．III，223 （u．uddiṭṭha），239； S．IV，299； SnA 422．-- 2．explanation S．V，110 sq．； sa-uddesa （adj．） with （the necessary） expln．，point by point，in detail，D．I，13，81； III，111； A．III，418； It．99； Nd2 6171．-- 3．samaṇuddesa one marked as a Samaṇa，a novice （cp．sāmaṇera） D．I，151； M．III，128； A．IV，343； uddesa-bhatta special or specified food Vin．I，58 = 96，cp．II．175，propounding，recitation，repetition Vin．I，50 = II．228 （uddesena paripucchāya ovādena by recitation，questioning & advice）； II，219 （°ṁ dadāti to hold a recitation + paripucchaṁ d）； A．IV，114 （+ paripucchā）； V，50 sq．（pañho，u．veyyākaraṇaṁ）； Nd2 3852 （+ paripucchā）； J．I，116； Miln．257 （+paripucchā）．ek’uddesa a single repetition Vin．III，47； A．III，67，180； Miln．10，18．（Page 136）
U: UDDESA：[m] sự chỉ ra，sự thuật lại，đề nghị，sự phát biểu --ka [a] người chỉ ra，thuật lại --sika [a] sự chỉ ra，sự chú ý ghi nhớ --vassa cỡ tuổi của

（၁） အကျဉ်းပြဆို- ဟော- ကြောင်းဖြစ်သော စကားရပ်၊ အကျဉ်းစကား၊ အကျဉ်းဒေသနာ၊ ခေါင်းစဉ်။ မာတိကာ။မူရင်းကြည့်ပါ။
R:
uddesa：ဥဒေ္ဒသ （ပ） （ဥဒ်√ဒိသ်+ဏ）
အကျဉ်းညွှန်ပြခြင်း။ သရုပ်အားဖြင့် ပြခြင်း။ ပါတိမောက်ပြခြင်း။ ပါဠိသင်ခြင်း။ သုတ်။
ဥဒေ္ဒသတော၊ ပါဠိတော်အားဖြင့်။ ဥဒေ္ဒသတ္ထံ၊ ပါဠိသင်ခြင်း အကျိုးငှာ။ ဥဒေ္ဒသဝသေန၊ အကျဉ်းပြခြင်း၏ အစွမ်းဖြင့်။
DOP: uddesa m. [ S., BHS uddeśa], 1. recitation, instruction; indication; brief indication, brief statement; summary exposition ; Vin I 50, 28 (upajjhāyena bhikkhave saddhivihāriko saṅgahetabbo anuggahetabbo ~ena paripucchāya ovādena anusāsaniyā; Sp 982, 14 : ~o ti pāḷi-vacanaṃ); II 169, 5 (bhikkhū … ṭhitakā ~aṃ patimānentā kilamanti); D III 56, 13 (~ā no cāvetukāmo samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ āhā ti); M III 187, 18 (~aṃ ca vibhaṅgaṃ ca desissāmi); S IV 93, 13 (saṅkhittena ~aṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā); V 110, 6 (h’ idaṃ ~aṃ āgacchati); A I 230, 19 (idaṃ … diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ ~aṃ āgacchati); IV 114, 22 (ayaṃ kālo ~assa; Mp IV 57, 18 : ayaṃ buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhanakālo); Ja III 38, 26´ (~aṃ gaṇha aṭṭhakathaṃ suṇa bhāvanaṃ anuyuñja); Mil 162, 30 (~o paripucchā); Vism 423, 8 (nāmagottaṃ ~o); Sp 993, 1 (~e ti pāḷi-pariyāpuṇane); Ps IV 109, 18 (āveṇikaṃ kammaṃ vā ~aṃ vā karonti); V 21, 19 (ayaṃ ~o ti idaṃ mātikāṭhapanaṃ); Kkh 2, 4 (bhikkhupātimokkhe pañca ~ā nāma); Sadd 920, 13 (samāsavacanaṃ ~o, vitthāravacanaṃ niddeso); — ifc see ek’-; — 2. instructing, specifying; inviting; food for a specific person ; Th 284 (~am ca na sādiyiṃ; Th-a II 120, 3 : ~an ti nimantanaṃ, uddissakatan ti keci); Sp 1249, 30 (dasa vā bhikkhū saṅghato uddisitvā dethā ti evaṃ ~ena laddhabhikkhūnaṃ bhattaṃ); — 3. [ cf S. uddeśya], that to which one refers, point of authority ; Sp 567, 16 (attā ~o assā ti attuddesā); Sv 548, 13 (ahaṃ uddisitabbaṭṭhena ~o assā ti mamuddesiko); — ifc see aññasatthār’- ( sv añña 2 ), att’- ( sv atta[n] ), samaṇ’-; — °- bhatta , n. , food specially prepared for a specific number of persons ; Vin I 58, 13 ; Kv 552, 9 ; Vism 66, 11 ; Sp 1249, 28 ; Dhp-a IV 176, 10 (ekā kira brāhmaṇī catunnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ~aṃ sajjetvā); — anuddesa , m. , lack of instruction; lack of recitation ; Ud-a 296, 24 ; 299, 11 (pātimokkhassa ~o); — sa-uddesa , mfn. , with a specification; with a brief description ; Vin III 4, 30 (iti sākāraṃ ~aṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi; Sp 161, 10 : nāmagottavasena ~aṃ vaṇṇādivasena sākāraṃ) ≠ M I 35, 16 ≠ It 99, 12 ≠ Paṭis I 114, 26 ≠ Mil 80, 4 ; Vism 423, 5 .
CPD: uddesa , m. [ sa. uddeśa], 1. "pointing out", in- dication, explanation; instruction, teaching ( mostly im- parted in form of recitation of canonical texts, esp. the pātimokkha); 2. indication in outline ( epex. syn. mātikā; opp. in old texts vibhaṅga, post-can. niddesa); 3. short for °-bhatta: almsfood prepared for a particular person; — 1. yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi ~ehi nāma-kāyassa (rūpa-kāyassa, nāma-rū- passa) paññatti hoti . . . , D ll 62, 14 foll. ( trsl. Rhys Davids "exponents"; ?, cf . sa-uddesa "in detail" ?); — eko pañho, eko ~o, ekaṃ veyyākara- ṇaṃ .... dasa pañhā, dasa ~ā . . . , S lV 299, 28 — 300, 2 = A V 50, 6-14 , cf. Pj l 82, 19 ; bhikkhū Upālissa santike ṭhitakā ~aṃ patimānentā kilamanti, Vin ll 169, 5 ; ~ā no cāvetu-kāmo samaṇo Gotamo evam āha, D lll 56, 13 (attano anusāsaniṃ gāhāpetvā amhe am- hākaṃ ~ato cāvetu-kāmo, Sv 842, 37 ); °'atthaṃ Rohaṇaṃ agamāsi, Vism 91, 23 (mhṭ see uddisāpana); ime āyasmā °âdīhi saṅgaṇhatu, 94, 2 ; thero ~aṃ ud- disati, Dhp-a l 382, 16 ; tumhe diva ~añ ca sāyaṃ ~añ ca main oloketvā ṭhapetha, Mp l 39, 28 ≠ 41, 17 ; — (pātimokkha:) pane' eva ~ā, Vin V 148, 10 (Kkh 2, 4 : bhikkhu-pātimokkhe pañca ~ā nāma: nidān'~o, pārājik'~o, saṅghâdises'~o, aniyat'~o, vitthār'~o; cf . Vin-vn 2575, Mil 333, 14 ); pañcah' ākārehi saṅgho bhijjati: kammena, ~ena . . . , Vin V 201, 13 , quoted Ps lV 108, 25 ; Mp ll 4, 2 ; Ud-a 316, 28 (~enā ti pañ- casu pātimokkh'~esu aññatarena ~ena, Sp 1377, 31 = Ps lV 108, 25 etc. ); yadā pana cattāro vā atirekā vā . . . āveṇikaṃ kammaṃ vā ~aṃ vā karonti, tadā saṅgho bhinno nāma hoti, Ps lV 109, 18 ≠ lt-a l 68, 26; . . . puggalassa ~ā saṅghassa uddiṭṭhaṃ hoti pāti- mokkhaṃ, Vin V 177, 27 , quoted Kkh 14, 13 ; — ~ followed by paripucchā ( interrogation, check-back by pupils ): . . . na tibba-cchando hoti ~e paripucchāya adhisīle +, Vin l 70, 16 (~e ti pāḷi-pariyāpuṇane, Sp 993, 1 ); (bhikkhū) riñcanti ~aṃ paripucchaṃ adhisī- lam +, 190, 5 = lll 235, 3, 10 ; anāpatti ~aṃ dento, paripuccham dento, lV 53, 34 ; ekacce pabbajitā pi nissaye pi diyyamāne ~e pi diyyamāne paripucchāya pi diyyamānāya + . . .na suṇanti. . . , Nidd ll 195, 5 ; ~aṃ vā paripucchaṃ vā dento, Vism 93, 25 ; ayaṃ kālo ~assa (paripucchāya +), A lV 114, 22 foll. (Mp lV 57, 18 : buddha-vacanaṃ uggaṇhana-kālo), quoted Spk l 50, 9 ; moha-caritaṃ bhagavā puggalaṃ ~e paripucchāya . . . niveseti, Nidd l 359, 25 = 453, 24 (~e ti sajjhāyane, Nidd-a l 385, 8 ); see further Nidd ll 192, 13 ; Mil 264, 11, 16 ; 408, 4 ; Spk l 279, 1 ; — upaj- jhāyena saddhivihāriko saṅgahetabbo anugahetabbo ~ena paripucchāya ovādena anusāsaniyā, Vin l 50, 28; ll 228, 2 (~o ti pāḷi-vacanaṃ, Sp 982, 14 ); ~ena ovādena anusāsaniyā anuggahaṃ karonto, Th-a lll 138, 22 ; kuto, ayye, ovādaṃ ~aṃ paripucchaṃ labhatha ?, Sp 786, 24 ; ~āya vā ovādāya vā āgatā, 662, 9 ; — ~aṃ deti: . . . na vuḍḍhaṃ anāpucchā ~o dātabbo, Vin ll 219, 35 ; thero sāmaṇerassa imam ~aṃ deti: . . . , Spk ll 274, 21 ; ~aṃ dentena, pāḷiṃ vācen- tenā ti attho, Vinayāl-ṭ B e ll 321, 15 ad uddisantena; therassa hi anupadaṃ ~aṃ dadamāno, As 15, 36 ; above Nidd ll 195, 5 ; Vism 93, 25 ; — ~aṃ gaṇhāti: Mp l 38, 15 ; lt-a ll 68, 3 ; ~aṃ gaṇha, aṭṭhakathaṃ suṇa, Ja lll 38, 26 '; bhikkhu . . . n'eva ~aṃ gaṇhi na sajjhāyaṃ akāsi, l 116, 19 = Dhp-a l 244, 11 ; na sajjhāyati na ~aṃ sampaṭicchāpetuṃ sakkoti, Dhp-a l 382, 24 ; ~am āgacchati: ayam . . . dhammo suttâ- gato . . . anvaddhamāsaṃ ~aṃ āgacchati, Vin lV 144, 13 ≠ 207, 2 ; 223, 2 ≠ A l 230, 19 ; 231, 21 etc.; dvīsu vinayesu paññattā ~aṃ āgacchanti uposathesu: kati te sikkhāpadā honti ?, Vin V 144, 4, 8 ; iti h' idaṃ ~aṃ āgacchati, S V 110, 6 — 111, 29 = As 145, 22 (Spk lll 170, 5 : ~aṃ āgacchatī ti gaṇanaṃ gacchati, "thus is . . . to be counted"; Woodward: "that is what is meant"; cf. uddesavibhaṅgasutta.p: [Uddesavibhaṅga+sutta] (na) CL=7 Uddesavibhaṅga sutta, A sutta that preaches vibhaṅga that is the summarized manual and Uddesa.
pn: Uddesavibhaṅgasutta. The Buddha utters the brief statement that a monk should always so guard his mind that it may not be externally diffused nor internally set. The monks repeat this statement to Mahā Kaccāna, who gives a detailed exposition thereof. When the Buddha is told of Kaccāna’s explanation, he praises his erudition (MN.iii.223ff).
a: ဥဒ္ဒေသဝိဘင်္ဂသုတ္တ(န)
[ဥဒ္ဒေသဝိဘင်္ဂ+သုတ္တ]
ဥဒ္ဒေသဝိဘင်္ဂသုတ်၊ အကျဉ်းချုပ် မာတိကာဟူသော ဥဒ္ဒေသနှင့် အကျဉ်းချုပ် မာတိကာဟူသော ဝိဘင်းတို့ကို ဟောကြားရာသုတ်။
